TIL of parasitic wasps, Ichneumonidae, that have an estimated 100,000 species. More than all vertabrates combined.
One of the creepiest insect related things I've ever seen.

Parasitic wasps are awesome. We got to study their life progression in Invertebrate Zoology lab. Basically, depending on the population metrics (number of males/females, desirability of hatching location) females will either have wings long enough to allow them to fly away and find better location, or short wings that allow them to stay in the same general area. Males will never have wings, and they never leave where they hatched.

The wasps have no interest in humans whatsoever, but they kill baby flies and other insects while they are in the pupal stages, so really, parasitic wasps are bros. They kill flies so you don't have to.

Generally private for-profit companies don't even need boards of directors, and when they have them they are generally made up of the principle investors, and sometimes outside specialists like lawyers, bankers, CPAs, marketing/PR people, etc.

In this case, it sounds to me like Pao was the fall guy (or fall gal) for decisions and missteps Ohanian/kn0thing made -- specifically the firing of Victoria and the communication problems around it. Certainly she was ultimately responsible as the CEO, but I get the sense that Ohanian's position as chairman of the board, investor, and co-founder allows him considerably more clout and responsibility that most people assumed -- yes, they knew he fired Victoria, but probably assumed it was at Pao's instruction or approval. I get the sense that Pao was in a relatively week position compared to Ohanian.

But still I think Pao needed to leave even though Ohanian was probably the bigger problem -- this change allows Reddit some time to quickly make some changes to improve the moderator experience and improve communication with the mods and the rest of the community. They need to show some fast improvements, but also chart of course to major upgrades, all while maintaining the positive communication.
